blocks.text: Opening the project puts all folders on the path and runs `scripts/shaddad_startup.m`, which:

items: creates the parameters `P`, the sample times `Ts`, the variant controls `VC_*` and the 88 `Bus_*` objects in the base workspace;
prints a product report that shows what is installed ({fig:F16_matlab_desktop_crop.png}). `MISSING` next to Simulink Coder only means code generation is not available; simulation works.

blocks.caption: MATLAB desktop with the Shaddad_UGV project open and the startup report in the Command Window.

blocks.text: To look at the models in Simulink:

open_system('Shaddad_System');        % top model
open_system('Shaddad_MCU');           % STM32 firmware model
close_system('Shaddad_System', 0);    % close without saving
Never edit and save the `.slx` files by hand. Every model is generated by a script in `scripts/build/` (see {sec:um07_params}).

blocks.caption: Folders you will use
rows: `phase1_test_drive.m`, `run_scenario.m`; `scenarios/` holds the scenario definitions; `build/` the model generators
